prompt: Who was the winner of the Nobel Peace Prize the year that U.S. President Barack Obama awarded baseball player Willie Mays the Presidential Medal of Freedom?
answer: In **2015**, President Barack Obama awarded Willie Mays the Presidential Medal of Freedom. The **2015 Nobel Peace Prize** went to the **Tunisian National Dialogue Quartet**.
